title: Signal Cartographer
description: A PC-first tactical map survival game about scanning hostile signal lanes, placing limited beacons, recovering fragments, and opening an exit through a moving storm field.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: Deep Field is PC-first. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, map touch target movement, and action buttons in local browser viewports, but keyboard-first route control is the intended experience. No physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Top-level provenance reflects the current canonical Deep Field remake. The original 2026-05-31 GPT-5.5 xhigh baseline remains preserved as an archived variant and run record. Code and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.
